title: NIS2 Control Library — Framework Mapping File
description: Schema for every framework-mapping JSON file under data/ (nis2-controls.json, iso27001-mapping.json, bsi-it-grundschutz-mapping.json, cis-v8-mapping.json, nist-csf-v2-mapping.json, dora-mapping.json, owasp-asvs-v4-mapping.json) AND for the derived crosswalk file (check-crosswalk.json — see oneOf below). Every PR that adds a new framework MUST validate against this schema (CI lint workflow enforces it).

$schema.description: Reference to this schema. New files SHOULD use the canonical published URL; legacy files reference the old saasfort.com placeholder.

title.description: Human-readable name of the mapping (e.g. 'SaaSFort NIS2 Article 21 Control Library').

description.description: Optional one-paragraph description shown in tooling.

source.description: Authoritative source the mapping is derived from (e.g. 'NIS2 Directive (EU) 2022/2555 Article 21').

scope_note.description: Honest disclosure of WHICH parts of the framework this mapping covers and which it intentionally omits (e.g. 'governance subcategories absent — verified from documentation, not external scans'). Required for any partial mapping.

generated_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when the file was generated (informational; not enforced).

license.description: Mapping data is published under MIT. Not the framework text itself — that retains its original license.

repository.description: URL of the canonical repo. Currently github.com/saasfort/nis2-controls.

controls.description: Per-control entries. Required for primary framework files; absent in the derived crosswalk file.

frameworks.description: Crosswalk only — list of framework slugs covered.

checks.description: Crosswalk only — per-check inverted index entries.

oneOf.title: Crosswalk file (derived view, no single source)

control.description: Stable control identifier from the source framework (e.g. 'NIS2 Art.21(2)(e)', 'ISO27001 A.8.20', 'CIS-03', 'NIST.PR.DS', 'DORA Art. 9', 'ASVS V9 — Communications').

title.description: Human-readable control title from the source framework.

category.description: Optional sub-category grouping (e.g. 'APP' for BSI APP.* modules, 'Identify' for NIST CSF function).

function.description: NIST-CSF-only: top-level function (Identify / Protect / Detect / Respond / Recover / Govern).

implementation_groups.description: CIS-only: implementation groups the control applies to.

checks.description: List of SaaSFort scanner check names that contribute evidence for this control. Names MUST match the canonical check names used across all framework files (case-sensitive).

evidence_types.description: Auditor-facing evidence types that pair with the technical signal (e.g. 'Risk register', 'Penetration test report', 'Cipher allow-list').

controls.description: Per-framework array of control IDs that reference this check.

framework_count.description: Count of distinct frameworks that map this check.
